```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dbscan)
```
## Get orthologous genes 
```{r}
# Read simsearch output
pannagram_1_1_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/coordinates_without_genes.csv", header=T, sep=",")
colnames(pannagram_1_1_genes) <- c("thaliana_id", "lyrata_start", "lyrata_end","lyrata_chr")
## Intersect with thaliana ids
genes_athaliana <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")  %>% filter(V3=="gene")
genes_athaliana$gene_id <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+);.*", "\\1", genes_athaliana$V9)
genes_athaliana[, gene_id_clean := sub("Parent=([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", gene_id)]
genes_athaliana <- genes_athaliana %>% dplyr::select(V1,V4,V5,gene_id_clean)
colnames(genes_athaliana) <- c("chr_thal", "star_thal", "end_thal", "gene_id_thal")
## Connect coordinates to genes 
pannagram_1_1_genes <- inner_join(pannagram_1_1_genes,genes_athaliana, by=c("thaliana_id"="gene_id_thal"))
## Write a table 
#pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>% dplyr::select(chr_thal,star_thal,end_thal)
#pannagram_1_1_genes$star_thal=pannagram_1_1_genes$star_thal-1
#write.table(pannagram_1_1_genes, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/1to1_genes_coordinates_thaliana.bed", quote = F, row.names = F, sep="\t")
```

## Dotplot thaliana-lyrata 
```{r}
# Change chromosome names in lyrata
pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr <- case_when(
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000001.1" ~ "Chr1",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000112.1" ~ "Chr2",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000223.1" ~ "Chr3",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000334.1" ~ "Chr4",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000445.1" ~ "Chr5",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000556.1" ~ "Chr6",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000667.1" ~ "Chr7",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000762.1" ~ "Chr8",
  TRUE ~ pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr)

## Get the chromosome length 
thal_lengths <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  group_by(chr_thal) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_pos = max(end_thal)) %>%
  arrange(chr_thal) %>%
  mutate(cum_start = lag(cumsum(max_pos), default = 0))

# Build the cumulative positions for A. lyrata
lyr_lengths <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  group_by(lyrata_chr) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_pos = max(lyrata_end)) %>%
  arrange(lyrata_chr) %>%
  mutate(cum_start = lag(cumsum(max_pos), default = 0))

# Add cumulative positions to the main df
pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  left_join(thal_lengths %>% dplyr::select(chr_thal, cum_start), by = "chr_thal") %>%
  dplyr::rename(cum_start_thal = cum_start) %>%
  left_join(lyr_lengths %>% dplyr::select(lyrata_chr, cum_start), by = "lyrata_chr") %>%
  dplyr::rename(cum_start_lyr = cum_start) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cum_pos_thal = cum_start_thal + (star_thal + end_thal) / 2,
    cum_pos_lyr = cum_start_lyr + (lyrata_start + lyrata_end) / 2
  )

# Detect transposed genes 
pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  mutate(
    nn_dist = kNNdist(cbind(cum_pos_thal, cum_pos_lyr), k = 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(chr_thal, lyrata_chr) %>%
  mutate(n_in_group = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(is_isolated = nn_dist > 1e6)

# Mark fridgida gene

p <- ggplot(pannagram_1_1_genes, aes(x = cum_pos_thal / 1e6, y = cum_pos_lyr / 1e6)) +
  geom_point(color = "#1E104E", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pannagram_1_1_genes, is_isolated),
             shape = 21, size = 1, fill = "#1E104E", color = "#1E104E", stroke = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pannagram_1_1_genes, thaliana_id == "AT4G00650"),
             shape = 21, size = 3, fill = "#FF653F", color = "#1E104E", stroke = 1) +
  labs(x = "A. thaliana cumulative position (Mbp)", y = "A. lyrata cumulative position (Mbp)") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)
p
ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/transposed_genes_onlyfrigida.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 150, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```
## Flanking genes analysis 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
window_bp <- 1000000      # 1 Mb neighbourhood in both species
max_neighbours <- 2    # retain only points with <= 2 nearby plotted genes
# Positions for every gene in the dot plot
reference_positions <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  transmute(
    ref_id = thaliana_id,
    chr_thal,
    lyrata_chr,
    ref_x = cum_pos_thal,
    ref_y = cum_pos_lyr
  )

# Positions for existing neighbourhood-disruption candidates
candidate_positions <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  transmute(
    focal_id = thaliana_id,
    chr_thal,
    lyrata_chr,
    focal_x = cum_pos_thal,
    focal_y = cum_pos_lyr
  )

# Count other genes close in BOTH x and y coordinates.
# Genes in a diagonal block will have many close local points.
candidate_2d_density <- candidate_positions %>%
  inner_join(
    reference_positions,
    by = c("chr_thal", "lyrata_chr")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    focal_id != ref_id,
    abs(focal_x - ref_x) <= window_bp,
    abs(focal_y - ref_y) <= window_bp
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(focal_id, name = "n_local_2d_neighbours")

# Keep candidate genes that are spatially isolated in the dot plot
neighbourhood_candidates_filtered <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  left_join(
    candidate_2d_density,
    by = c("thaliana_id" = "focal_id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_local_2d_neighbours = coalesce(n_local_2d_neighbours, 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(n_local_2d_neighbours <= max_neighbours)

moved_genes <- ggplot(
  pannagram_1_1_genes,
  aes(x = cum_pos_thal / 1e6, y = cum_pos_lyr / 1e6)
) +
  geom_point(color = "#053061", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = neighbourhood_candidates_filtered,
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.5,
    fill = "#d6604d",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(pannagram_1_1_genes, thaliana_id == "AT4G00650"),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    fill = "#238443",
    color = "#1E104E",
    stroke = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "A. thaliana cumulative position (Mbp)",
    y = "A. lyrata cumulative position (Mbp)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)


ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/transposed_genes.png",
       plot = moved_genes,
       width = 130, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

## Check presence of introns 
# Idea: genes without introns signatures are more likely TEs
```{r}
# Load gff of athaliana 
athaliana_gff <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")
ath_genes_gff <- athaliana_gff[V3 == "CDS",]
ath_genes_gff[, gene_id := sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", V9)]
## Map to the genes 
single_moved_genes_mapped <- inner_join(neighbourhood_candidates_filtered,ath_genes_gff, by=c("thaliana_id"="gene_id"))
## Check presene of introns
# Extract exons for moved genes only
ath_exons <- athaliana_gff[V3 == "exon"]
ath_exons[, gene_id := sub(".*Parent=([^.]+).*", "\\1", V9)]
# Count exons per gene introns = exons - 1
gene_structure <- ath_exons[gene_id %in% neighbourhood_candidates_filtered$thaliana_id,
                             .(n_exons = .N), by = gene_id]
gene_structure[, n_introns := n_exons - 1]
gene_structure[, has_intron := n_introns >= 1]
genes_with_introns_lyrata_thaliana <- gene_structure[gene_structure$has_intron=="TRUE",]
```
## Write a table of moved genes 
```{r}
## Get positions in thaliana and lyrata
genes_with_introns_lyrata_thaliana_with_coordinates <- inner_join(genes_with_introns_lyrata_thaliana,pannagram_1_1_genes, by=c("gene_id"="thaliana_id"))

write.table(genes_with_introns_lyrata_thaliana_with_coordinates, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/98_1to1_orth_moved_genes.csv", quote=F, row.names = F, sep="\t")
```
